title: Rich operator messages: formatted tells + attachments
description:
Rough scope (flesh out when fronted): teach the operator channel the rich message elements the transport already supports — demoed live 2026-08-16 via raw Bot API, chosen by the operator over the channel itself (multi-select answer: formatted-tells + attachments).

Deliverables sketch:
- Channel interface: additive methods for formatted text and attachments (SendFormatted or a message struct with markup flag; SendAttachment for documents/photos with optional caption + gate buttons). Telegram impl (HTML parse mode, sendDocument/sendPhoto), FakeChannel, fakebot coverage.
- CLI: tk tell --format (or auto-detected markdown subset) and tk tell --file <path>; tk ask photo+gate shape for content review.
- Keep Send plain-text contract intact (review decision, epic 54v); formatting is a new path, never re-interpretation of existing text.
- Interlocks with epic 7ab (tick attachments / screenshots for content review): 7ab produces the screenshots, this epic delivers them to the phone with approve/reject under the standard gate provenance rules.
- Channel-neutral: every element must be expressible in Slack Block Kit terms before it lands in the interface.

acceptance_criteria:
[A50] go test -short -count=1 ./internal/operator/... ./cmd/tk/... passes covering formatted sends, document and photo attachments, and the photo+gate ask via FakeChannel and fakebot.
[A51] tk tell --format delivers formatted text (fakebot asserts the markup arrives intact and the plain-text path is unchanged: escaped exactly once); unconfigured still exits 4.
[A52] tk tell --file <path> delivers an attachment (photo for image extensions, document otherwise) with optional --caption; unconfigured still exits 4 with zero HTTP.
[A53] tk ask --photo <path> --gate approve delivers a photo with approve/reject buttons and a tap resolves with the same unforgeable human provenance as text gates (verdict + [human] note + message caption edit).
[A54] The channel interface additions are channel-neutral: FakeChannel implements them, no Telegram type leaks outside internal/operator/telegram, and each new element is documented with its Slack Block Kit equivalent in the interface godoc.
[A55] (human judgment) Each shipped element is demoed LIVE to the operator's Telegram using the shipped tk commands themselves — a formatted tell, a file tell (document), a photo tell, and a photo+gate ask resolved by the operator's tap — and the operator approves the demo via that final gate.
